entities.name: Nautilus
entities.description: Creature type for cephalopods of the family Nautilidae with spiral chambered shells.

entities.name: Hermitic Nautilus
entities.description: Artifact creature of Ixalan that devours a shell's original occupant before living in it.

entities.name: Chambered Nautilus
entities.description: Mercadian nautilus that grows several feet long; Saprazzan artisans used its shells for jewelry.

entities.name: Crystalline Nautilus
entities.description: Theros nautilus that seems able to ride across waves.

entities.name: Monoist Circuit-Feeder
entities.description: Space-faring artifact creature of the Edge said to do to ships what the Monoist faith does to stars.

entities.name: Saprazzan
entities.description: Artisans who used Chambered Nautilus shells for jewelry.

entities.name: Monoist faith
entities.description: Faith said to do to stars what the Circuit-Feeders do to ships.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane home to the Hermitic Nautilus.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane home to the Chambered Nautilus.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane home to the Crystalline Nautilus.

relations.quote: On Ixlaan, the Hermitic Nautilus is an artifact creature
Mercadia is home to the Chambered Nautilus
Theros is home to the Crystalline Nautilus.
The Edge is home to space-faring artifact creatures known as Monoist Circuit-Feeders.
